name: Pinacoteca de São Paulo
funding: Maintainer B3; São Paulo state via APAC; Lei Rouanet. Master sponsors Bradesco, InfinitePay, Itaú, Vivo, Chanel. Gold sponsors include Equinor, Ultra, Bloomberg, J.P. Morgan, Motiva.
watch: Equinor is a state-majority oil and gas company and Ultra owns Ipiranga fuel distribution. Both are gold sponsors in the July 2026 panel.
why_flagged: Maintainer B3; São Paulo state via APAC; Lei Rouanet. Master sponsors Bradesco, InfinitePay, Itaú, Vivo, Chanel. Gold sponsors include Equinor, Ultra, Bloomberg, J.P. Morgan, Motiva.
records_note: Operator APAC posts annual reports for 2018 to 2025, audited accounts from 2006 and its council; the sponsor list is a July 2026 image.

name: Remai Modern
funding: C$13.1M revenue in 2025, 51% from City of Saskatoon grants. Sponsors include the Frank and Ellen Remai Foundation, SaskEnergy, SIGA, SaskTel, SGI and TD.
watch: SaskEnergy, Cameco uranium, Sask Lotteries. 2019 board upheaval.
records_note: It posts reports for 2016 to 2025 with a 2025 donor list and its board, but audited accounts are available only on request.

name: Frye Art Museum
funding: Charles and Emma Frye's bequest runs the museum as a private operating foundation. FY2025 revenue: investment distributions 75.6 percent ($6.9M), donations 16.9 percent, store and events 8.1 percent.
watch: The Art Workers Union picketed on 10 April 2020 and petitioned after the museum laid off 21 part-time workers; the director denied union motives.
records_note: Posts annual reports for 2011 to 2025, a named 2025 donor list and its trustees; Form 990 filings run 2001 to 2024 on ProPublica.

name: Henry Art Gallery
funding: $4.8M. City of Seattle, 4Culture, Washington State Arts Commission and NEA; Frankenthaler and ArtsFund funds; sponsors include Phillips and Pyramid Breweries.
watch: Museum of the University of Washington in Seattle.
records_note: Annual reports from FY2015-16 to FY2024-25 are on its site, 990s are on ProPublica, a named funders page is undated, and trustees are listed.

name: Art Sonje Center
watch: Private non-profit contemporary kunsthalle in Seoul founded by Chung Hee-ja.
records_note: Its site posts no annual reports, accounts, sponsor names or board; it links the Daewoo Foundation and invites corporate sponsors only.

name: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (MMCA)
funding: State museum. Hyundai Motor sponsored its series from 2014 to February 2024; LG Electronics sponsors the OLED Series from 2025. The Lee Kun-hee estate gave nearly 1,500 works in 2021.
watch: Hyundai Motor sponsored its series to February 2024. Reuters found children as young as 12 at Hyundai subsidiary SMART Alabama in 2022.
records_note: The state museum posts no annual report, accounts, sponsor list or board on its site; its sponsorship page points to a separate foundation site.

name: Rockbund Art Museum
funding: Private museum in the Rockbund development on the Bund. Current credits name the Octone Foundation and ROCKBUND; no funder list or budget is published.
watch: Non-profit contemporary museum located in the historic Royal Asiatic Society building in Shanghai. Governed under Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau non-profit regulations with curatorial independence.
records_note: Its support page names founders Lynn and Thomas Ou and lead sponsors Rockbund and Ping An, undated; no annual report, accounts or board are posted.

name: Bundanon
funding: Revenue A$14.5M and 133,513 visitors (2024-25). Commonwealth grant A$10.1M. Partners include Landcare Australia, Oranges & Sardines Foundation, Minter Ellison, ADCO and the Gordon Darling Foundation.
watch: Donor roll is individuals and family foundations, including the late Paul Ramsay. No flagged funder found.
records_note: Posts annual reports from 2006-07 with financial statements, a named 2024-25 donor roll and a 12-member board list.

name: Singapore Art Museum (SAM)
funding: State, under Singapore's Visual Arts Cluster, plus corporate partners.

name: The Model
watch: Regional contemporary arts center in Sligo.
records_note: No annual report; posts 2024 audited accounts and a 15-member board with company secretary, and a footer funder-logo image with no names or date.

name: Pulitzer Arts Foundation
watch: 501(c)(3) private operating foundation in St. Louis designed by Tadao Ando.
records_note: No annual reports or donor list on its site; 990-PF filings for 2001 to 2023 are on ProPublica, and the board is listed.

name: Magasin III
funding: Robert Weil Family Foundation, funded by the Weil family office Proventus.
watch: Private museum for contemporary art in Stockholm and Jaffa.
records_note: The museum posts nothing; its funding Weil Foundation names four board members but no reports, accounts or outside donors.
